title: SARS-CoV-2 Wastewater RNA Concentration and Extraction Protocol
author: Brett Rasile
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bn58mg9w

steps.title: Prepare Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Collect 500 mL of wastewater in a 500 mL or 1 L plastic sample bottle.

steps.title: Prepare BRSV Vaccine Dilution
steps.instruction: Create a 1:100 dilution of Zoetis Bovine Rhinotracheitis-Parainfluzena-Respiratory Syncytial Virus (BRSV) Vaccine in H2O.

steps.title: Spike and Mix Sample
steps.instruction: Spike the wastewater sample with the 1:100 BRSV dilution to achieve a final concentration of 1 µL/mL (e.g., 500 µL for a 500 mL sample).

substeps.instruction: Add the BRSV dilution to the wastewater.
Mix by aggressively inverting the bottle several times or shaking.

steps.title: Sediment Aggregates
steps.instruction: Incubate the spiked wastewater samples at room temperature (RT) for a minimum of 10 minutes to allow large aggregates to sediment.

steps.title: Transfer Wastewater Aliquot
steps.instruction: Using a 25 mL serological pipette, gently transfer the top 40 mL of the spiked wastewater to a 50 mL conical tube, ensuring sedimented particles at the bottom are not disturbed.

steps.title: Capture RNA with Magnetic Nanotrap
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL of Ceres Magnetic Nanotrap® particles to the 40 mL wastewater aliquot.

substeps.instruction: Place conical tubes into custom magnet racks.
Allow magnets to attract particles for a minimum of 20 minutes at RT until the supernatant is relatively clear.

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend Particles
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the Magnetic Nanotrap® particles in Buffer MWA1.

substeps.instruction: Keeping tubes fixed to magnets, carefully pour off the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Add 500 µL of Buffer MWA1 to the tubes.
Vortex to resuspend the pellets.
Incubate samples for 10 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Separate and Incubate Particles
steps.instruction: Separate the particles using magnets and incubate to incorporate them.

substeps.instruction: Place conical tubes on custom magnet racks to separate particles.
Invert the samples several times to incorporate the particles.
Incubate for 20 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Transfer Lysate to Deep Well Plate
steps.instruction: With tubes on the magnets, transfer 450 µL of lysate to a 2 mL deep well plate.

substeps.instruction: Use barcode labels to transfer sample IDs to a LIMS program.
Seal unused columns with non-pierceable foil.

steps.title: Bind RNA to B-Beads
steps.instruction: Add 475 µL of Buffer MWA2 and 25 µL of NucleoMag® B-Beads to the lysate in the deep well plate.

substeps.instruction: Shake the sample plate for 5 minutes at 1400 rpm.
Place the plate on a plate magnet for at least 5 minutes until B-beads completely precipitate.
Remove supernatant using a multichannel pipette, ensuring beads are not removed (if beads are drawn up, dispense back and incubate on magnet for a few minutes).

steps.title: Perform First Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the B-beads with Buffer MWA3.

substeps.instruction: Add 850 µL of Buffer MWA3 to each well.
Shake the sample plate for 2 minutes at 1400 rpm.
Place the plate on a plate magnet for at least 2 minutes to separate B-beads.
Remove the supernatant using a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Perform Second Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the B-beads a second time with Buffer MWA3.

substeps.instruction: Add 850 µL of Buffer MWA3 to each well.
Shake the sample plate for 2 minutes at 1400 rpm.
Place the plate on a plate magnet for at least 2 minutes to separate B-beads.
Remove the supernatant using a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Perform Final Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the B-beads with Buffer MWA4.

substeps.instruction: Add 850 µL of Buffer MWA4 to each well.
Shake the sample plate for 2 minutes at 1400 rpm.
Place the plate on a plate magnet for 2 minutes to separate B-beads.
Remove as much supernatant as possible using a multichannel pipette to avoid PCR failure.

steps.title: Dry the Beads
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a shaker at 56 °C for approximately 30 minutes to air dry the beads completely to remove residual EtOH.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA from the B-beads using RNase-free H2O.

substeps.instruction: Add 60 µL of RNase-free H2O to each well.
Shake the sample plate for 5 minutes at 500 rpm.
Place the sample plate on a plate magnet for 2 minutes to separate B-beads.
Transfer the eluted RNA to a 96-well elution plate.
